privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.description: Read what this demo does with form data and how external links work.

sections.heading: What data we process
sections.body: The contact and newsletter forms only validate in your browser. In this demo, the name, email address and message you enter are not sent to a backend or stored by the app. The hosting environment may process technical request data; check the policy of the administrator of that installation.

sections.heading: Cookies and analytics
sections.body: This frontend does not configure analytics or marketing services. The hosting environment may use its own technical cookies or logs; those are outside this demo app. External stores may set their own cookies after you open their websites.

sections.heading: External links and stores
sections.body: Coupon codes and deals link through to the store's website. Once you click such a link, the privacy policy of that store applies. We have no control over how external parties handle your data; review their policy before sharing any information.

sections.heading: Newsletter
sections.body: Newsletter sign-up is not connected in this demo. The browser only validates the email address; no subscription is sent and no mailing list is updated. Update this text when a newsletter provider is connected.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: You can contact us using the email address on the contact page. This demo form does not submit requests, and this frontend makes no processing-time promise. The administrator of a production installation must update this information to match its actual data processing.
